features.title: One guarded way to serve and show a changed image
features.summary: Name the previewable image types, answer with their bytes under nosniff and a sandboxing policy within an 8 MB cap, and read them into a blob URL in the browser.
failureModes: A file whose extension is not a previewable image type is never served as one.
An SVG served this way runs no script even when its URL is opened directly.

verification.testName: names the media type of each previewable image extension, in any case
serves the bytes under their media type, unsniffed, uncached and sandboxed

telemetry.reason: Pure functions and a browser hook; the routes that call them own their spans.

ioDelegation.reason: Browser hook: it reads a preview route whose Host owner opens the span (diffs-review image read, the deliverables changes.image route).
